boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: A documented set of SDSU Homecoming, sustainability, and Native community traditions.

cards.title: SDSU Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual fall return to Montezuma Mesa
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming events page each fall, then join a scheduled campus activity or football-game gathering that fits your plans.
cards.short_summary: SDSU’s formal Homecoming tradition began in 1933 and continues as a week-long fall celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU says Homecoming formally started in 1933 and remains an annual fall tradition welcoming alumni, students, staff, and the community.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by year; consult SDSU Homecoming listings before attending.

cards.title: Homecoming Court
cards.subtitle: Student-organization nominees recognized at Homecoming
cards.notes: Watch for the annual court announcement and halftime recognition; support nominees through their student organizations and official events.
cards.short_summary: Student organizations nominate leaders for selection to SDSU’s Homecoming Court.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU documents that student leaders are nominated annually by their organizations to be selected for the Homecoming Court.
cards.access_notes: Participation and nomination processes are organized through annual Homecoming programming.

cards.title: Homecoming Spirit Trophy
cards.subtitle: Spirit-week recognition for student teams
cards.notes: Join a registered student team during Homecoming Spirit Week and follow the year’s official competition rules and event schedule.
cards.short_summary: Student teams compete during Homecoming Spirit Week for prizes and the Spirit Trophy.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU states that student teams compete during Homecoming Spirit Week for prizes including the Homecoming Spirit Trophy and halftime recognition.
cards.access_notes: Competition details and eligibility vary with the annual Homecoming program.

cards.title: Punt, Pass, Kick
cards.subtitle: Annual Homecoming halftime event
cards.notes: Attend the Homecoming football game and look for the halftime program; follow event staff directions if a participation option is offered.
cards.short_summary: Punt, pass, kick is the current annual halftime activity in SDSU Homecoming history.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU’s Homecoming history identifies punt, pass, kick as the annual halftime event, replacing earlier push-ball matches.
cards.access_notes: Occurs as part of annual Homecoming programming; game admission or participation terms may apply.

cards.title: Carnival and T-Shirt Swap
cards.subtitle: A current SDSU Homecoming activity pair
cards.notes: Bring an eligible shirt only if the year’s swap instructions request one, and check the Homecoming schedule for the carnival location.
cards.short_summary: SDSU lists a carnival and T-shirt swap among its current Homecoming traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU identifies a carnival and T-shirt swap among the traditions included in Homecoming today.
cards.access_notes: Dates, location, swap rules, and any costs are set in the annual Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: OneSDSU
cards.subtitle: A listed part of today’s Homecoming traditions
cards.notes: Look for OneSDSU on the annual Homecoming calendar and attend through the published event instructions and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: OneSDSU is one of the events SDSU names as part of its current Homecoming tradition set.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU’s Homecoming history lists the OneSDSU event among the traditions included today.
cards.access_notes: Format and attendance details are announced with each year’s Homecoming programming.

cards.title: GreenFest
cards.subtitle: Student-led sustainability week
cards.notes: Use the Associated Students GreenFest page to find the current week’s activities, then choose a public program that matches your schedule.
cards.short_summary: GreenFest is one of SDSU’s largest student-led events and is supported by the Student Traditions Committee.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU Associated Students says its Student Traditions Committee helps plan, support, and promote GreenFest as one of SDSU’s largest student-led events.
cards.access_notes: GreenFest activities occur during the announced annual week; individual event terms may differ.

cards.entity_name: San Diego State Annual Pow Wow
cards.title: SDSU Pow Wow
cards.subtitle: Annual Native community gathering at SDSU
cards.notes: Attend respectfully as a guest, follow Pow Wow etiquette and staff guidance, and use the Native Resource Center page for current details.
cards.short_summary: The annual SDSU Pow Wow brings Native American community members together at SDSU.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU describes its Pow Wow as an annual cultural and social event that brings together the Native American community at SDSU.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 page lists ENS 700/REC Field and says the event is free to all attendees; confirm future dates before going.

cards.title: Pow Wow Grand Entry
cards.subtitle: Ceremonial opening of SDSU’s annual Pow Wow
cards.notes: Arrive before the posted start and observe from designated areas; let the master of ceremonies and event staff guide participation.
cards.short_summary: The Grand Entry officially opens the SDSU Pow Wow as dancers and the color guard enter the arena.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU identifies Grand Entry as the official start of its Pow Wow, with dancers and the color guard entering the arena.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 program listed Grand Entry at noon; timing may change in future annual programs.

cards.title: The Cowles Mountain S
cards.subtitle: Historic SDSU Homecoming symbol, now reimagined on campus
cards.notes: Learn the history through SDSU’s account and seek only sanctioned campus displays; do not climb, paint, or alter Cowles Mountain.
cards.short_summary: A 1931 mountain-side S tradition is now remembered through safer, environmentally conscious campus reimaginings.
cards.evidence_claim: SDSU reports that safety and environmental concerns mean students will not paint the S atop Cowles Mountain again, while the tradition has been reimagined on campus.
cards.source_title: The Cowles Mountain S Yesterday and Today
cards.access_notes: Historic tradition only: do not attempt the former mountain painting or lighting practice; follow official Homecoming programming instead.
